<span data-as="p">When the market for an asset is closed, the stream continues with its last
known price and marks that value as carried forward. During market hours,
prices can update up to five times per second for each feed.</span>

<span data-as="p">Use the comments stream to keep conversations and reactions current wherever
your application displays Polymarket discussion. Comments can begin a thread or
reply to another comment; reply events include the parent comment’s ID.</span>
